defects: Mohammed (center-left boy in white tunic) has his head twisted nearly 90 degrees to screen-left toward the back of the red-fez boy, away from the slate he holds in front of his chest to fan himself.
tiles.fix: Orient Mohammed's head and gaze toward his slate or the fqih while fanning his face.

defects: Mohammed (center-left boy in white tunic) keeps his head turned sharply screen-left away from the slate he is fanning himself with.
tiles.fix: Keep Mohammed's head facing forward/three-quarters toward his slate as he fans himself.

defects: Mohammed (center-left boy in white tunic) has his head in full left profile staring at the back of the red-fez boy while holding his slate to his chest.
tiles.fix: Rotate Mohammed's head back toward his slate so the fanning action reads naturally.

defects: Both young women are scaled far too small relative to the sanctuary plate and the wooden tomb railing (the ochre-dressed woman on the left is barely the height of the railing, matching the 6-year-old boys' height in s04 44.1).
The foreground-left woman in ochre faces straight into the wooden railing rather than walking around the tomb perimeter, and her feet are hidden behind the foreground base of the railing.
tiles.fix: Scale both young women up to adult proportions (comparable to the fqih's height at the same depth) and orient the foreground-left woman along the path circling the tomb.

defects: The woman in green/yellow near the back-right corner of the tomb is scaled too small relative to the railing (her shoulders barely clear the top rail) and stands facing the camera rather than walking around the tomb.
The foreground-left woman in red/white faces straight into the tomb railing corner rather than following the circular path around the tomb.
tiles.fix: Increase the scale of the back-right woman to match adult proportions at that depth and pose both women walking along the perimeter path around the tomb.

defects: The fqih's right index finger is raised too high, pressing between his eyes/nose bridge instead of against his lips, and his wide right sleeve shows a dark clipping gap around the wrist.
tiles.fix: Lower the fqih's right hand so his index finger touches his lips cleanly and fix the wrist sleeve deformation.

defects: The boy in the blue tunic on the left is floating in mid-air with his feet high off the floor tiles behind Mohammed, and his head and neck clip directly into the tiled wall fountain niche/spout.

Mohammed (white tunic) crouches horizontally underneath the blue-tunic boy, colliding and clipping into the blue-tunic boy's chest and arms while reaching his hands into the solid masonry base below the fountain basin.
The fqih's black beard and mustache are completely missing (clipped inside his head mesh), leaving a bare pale lower face and chin in profile.
tiles.fix: Place both boys' feet firmly on the floor tiles in front of the fountain without overlapping each other, position their hands under the water spout, and restore the fqih's beard mesh.

defects: While the fqih faces away toward the back wall (qibla), all four boys in the row behind him are turned 90 degrees into left profile (facing the tomb on screen-left) in a single-file queue instead of standing side-by-side with their backs to the lens.
The four boys hold their empty hands raised in front of their chins as if holding invisible slates instead of standing in a proper qiyam prayer posture.
tiles.fix: Rotate all four boys ~90 degrees clockwise so they stand side-by-side facing the back wall behind the fqih (backs to the camera) in a proper qiyam pose.

defects: All five actors (the fqih and the four boys) bow in side profile toward screen-left (facing the tomb) instead of facing away from the lens toward the back wall.
Instead of a standing ruku bow from the waist with straight legs and hands on knees, all four boys collapse into contorted lunging crouches on bent knees.

The blue-tunic boy (second from left) and Mohammed (third from left) collide and intersect in the same space, and the tunics on all four boys tear and clip severely through their thighs, hips, and backs.
tiles.fix: Orient the fqih and the row of boys away from the camera toward the back wall, separate the boys evenly along the row, and pose them in a proper standing ruku (straight legs, flat back, hands on knees) without tunic clipping.

worst_problem: In s04 39.4 the boys collide and float into the wall fountain while the fqih loses his beard, and in s04 44.1–48.7 the prayer row faces screen-left instead of away from the lens, collapsing into intersecting lunges with severe tunic clipping during ruku.
